name: Isato
source:
One of the Eight Guardians. 
He acts as the Suzaku of Heaven for his era's White Dragon Priestess. 
Family: Father and mother, two unnamed elder brothers
Occupation: Apprentice monk
Innate Element: Fire
Weapon(s): Khakkhara (shakujou, Ringed monk staff)
Hobbies: "Staying on my feet" (moves around a lot)
Habit(s): Bites his thumbnail when he's nervous
Favorite Scent: Kayou
Favorite Color: Usubeni (light red)
Favorite Flower(s): Hardy begonia (autumn) / Christmas camellia (winter)

[From [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Koei Wiki[/url]]
